correctness.rationale: The normalized Funk action is -1/2 on trace-free quadratic harmonics. Fourier orthogonality at five distinct 5th roots makes the Gram diagonal with three stated eigenvalue factors. The minimax proof covers r in (0,1/4], [1/4,3/5], and [3/5,infinity), and the separate lower-bound proof covers t in (0,t*), (t*,1/3), [1/3,1/2], and [1/2,1). At the sole common t* the formulas for both sharp optima and multiplicities follow by substitution. The package checker passed 1353 tests; finite tests are corroboration, not an all-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: Read focal 2023 Funk frame paper, the 2018 spin sampling paper, and the relevant sections of the 2014 scalar iso-latitude paper. The first establishes the Funk harmonic multiplier and infinite-dimensional frame reconstruction, not finite optimal five-scan conditioning; the second uses a distinct full-band spin setting and heuristic latitude selection. Compared mathematical claims using topical and equivalent-formulation searches of published research records. No reviewed statement implies the pair of exact restricted single-ring quadratic optima. Publication priority remains provisional due unindexed work and a partially accessible abstract-only sphere interpolation paper.

value.rationale: The first nonconstant observable Funk band is a 5D quadrupole, so five scans are an information-theoretically minimal linear design. Fixed-tilt equal-azimuth acquisition is natural and physically realizable. The theorem supplies all singular modes, every failure latitude, a closed-form optimal scan tilt, a sharp global minimum condition number within that design family, and a separately sharp maximum minimum gain at exactly the same tilt; useful concrete spectral stability benchmark.
